quests.title: Leroy: Beautiful Friends

dialogue.t: (test)...
(test)... 您请回吧
This house is for sale. Very reasonable price — purchase before it's too late!
This house is for sale. Very reasonable price — purchase before it's too late!
Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}, Ms. Paimon, it seems like Mr. Leroy doesn't live here anymore! Have you seen him?
(Hey, do we want to tell the truth?)
So you did see him! Did you tell him the snacks were delicious?
I knew Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME} was trustworthy! You're the best. I brought some Bulle Fruit over — have some with me!

dialogue.sit: Molli sighs, and waves goodbye, and just as she is about to leave...
The door opens, and Autumn and Athos walk out.

dialogue.t: So it was your voices we heard outside. Is there still something you want?
Really? Small world. Autumn and I were just leaving.
Oh, he's already gone somewhere else. A place that we'll only be going after a few more decades. I don't think you will be seeing him anytime soon.
Though that's hard to say. Which will come first, tomorrow or an untimely end? Who knows?
Ah, and isn't this the little rascal who's always looking for him?
Hi, Lady!
...You look just like me. And you even have lavender eyes...
L—Lady, can I help you...?
How old are you?
I'm nine!
What are your parents' names?
Uh... Are you okay, Lady?
Your expression... Is something wrong with the kid? ... Wait, this can't be a coincidence, can it?
Are you adopted? Tell me.
...Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}, do you know this lady? What is she doing...
Who asks questions like that? Allow me.
Young miss, I remember you're very close with our Dad, right?
Yeah! Mr. Leroy treats me really well. Mr. Son-in-Law, does he not live here anymore?
That's right, he's gone somewhere very far away and won't be coming back again.
What does our Dad usually talk with you about? Can you tell me? When I go back, I can tell him how much you miss him.
Mr. Leroy always treats me to snacks, lets me pet Nana, and tells me my eyes are pretty!
Anything else?
He often tells me to say hi to my Mama and Papa for him, but they really don't like that...
Papa gets really angry and says that Mr. Leroy is a bad person, and that he's "blackmailing" them.
Though they've forbidden me from coming here, I made an agreement with Mr. Leroy, so I sneak over. Please don't tell Papa, Mister!
That's just like him. He won't stop squeezing until he's wrung the last drop of value out.
...That bastard. ...Sorry. We were talking about something else just now.
M—Mister, Lady, is there anything else? If not, then I—I'll just go home now.
...Do your mother and father love you?
They're the best parents in the whole wide world.
That's good, then.
I'm going home now! Bye, Lady! Bye, Mister!
Goodbye.

dialogue.sit: You don't plan on telling her?

dialogue.t: I have imagined this scene time and time again... But nothing is better than knowing that she's happy. That's enough for me.
I... I'm not my father. I don't want to cause trouble for her current family.
I don't mean to be that guy, but didn't you buy a music box for her? Are you not going to give it to her now?
No, there's no need. She... doesn't look like she lacks for things like that.
I'll think of ways to keep visiting her in the future. Whatever she needs, I'll find a way.
...I'll give the music box to someone else. After all, I spent a lot of time and effort picking it out.
Excuse me, little white-haired girl... Do you like gifts?
Do you mean Paimon? Wait, you want to give this to Paimon?
Yes, I do. It's a gift, so please, enjoy it. I hope it will still have some bit of value to you.
Sorry, Athos, but I think we'll need to stay in the Court of Fontaine a bit longer.
Don't worry, it's all the same to me. Let's go.

dialogue.sit: You watch the two of them walk away, leaving this street behind — thus does the story of the Leroy family draw to an end.

dialogue.t: This house is for sale. Very reasonable price — purchase before it's too late!
Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME} and Ms. Paimon! Are you guys here to talk to Mr. Leroy?
He isn't here. Father said Mr. Leroy will never live here again — he's gone to live underground.
Is it the same Fleuve Cendre we went to before?
If so, then no, not that place. Father said he's gone much deeper underground.
The Steambird said that Mr. Leroy fell from a very high place while climbing a mountain, and went tumbling down.
Though to be honest, I don't really know how having a bad fall and moving are connected...
By the way, I saw Mr. Leroy's son-in-law! And there was a very nice lady too.
The lady really liked me, and she has the same eyes as I do! Our eyes are both lavender.
She even asked me where I lived, and said she'd come see me if she had time, and be my good friend! I guess everyone in the Leroy family is a good person!
*sigh* I even brought some Bulle Fruit over for Mr. Leroy, but since he isn't there...
Can I give it to you, instead?
Thank you, Molli!
Don't mention it! Mama and Papa always say we should be generous with our friends.
I did another good thing today! I'm going to go back and write it in my diary, yay!

dialogue.sit: As you watch the happy Molli leave that street behind, the story of the Leroy family draws to an end.

quests.description: You find yourselves passing by the Leroy residence again…
